baselines.B2_vs_B0: B2 vs persistence on the same windows

24h.metric: absolute error of ln range (log units); negative difference favours the first model
24h.overlap_warning: 24h windows start every 4h and overlap 6-fold; consecutive pairs are dependent (about 0 non-overlapping windows)

4h.metric: absolute error of ln range (log units); negative difference favours the first model

72h.metric: absolute error of ln range (log units); negative difference favours the first model
72h.overlap_warning: 72h windows start every 4h and overlap 18-fold; consecutive pairs are dependent (about 0 non-overlapping windows)

evaluation.method: companion-eval-1 (2026-09-30): rc1d-eval-1 applied to B2 vs B1 on eligible paired windows
evaluation.note: Descriptive. B2 vs B0 here is restricted to windows with an eligible companion, so it can differ from reports/range_status.json (all eligible RC1D windows). Overlapping windows are dependent.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: moving-block bootstrap of paired differences, blocks of 42 decisions, 2000 resamples, seed 20260930, 95% interval; reported only from 10 blocks

evidence_class_rule: no pre-registered success threshold exists for the companion, so its ceiling is 'exploratory' (an interval with no decision rule); 'descriptive' below the block minimum; 'unavailable' with no scored pair; 'retired' once terminated
status: prospective record only; descriptive until rc1d-eval-1 block minimums are met
